description: Works out the FC 27 Pro Clubs AcceleRATE type (Explosive, Controlled or Lengthy) from height and the Acceleration, Agility and Strength a Pro has in the match, and lists which conditions pass or fail. Explosive: 182 cm or shorter, Agility 65+, Agility 10 above Strength, Acceleration 80+.

female.description: Female Pros use other height limits (162 cm Explosive, 172 cm Lengthy).

name: check_accelerate_type
title: AcceleRATE type for a build
